validate_build_yaml_attributes: run mako_plugin to validate filegroups, libs, and targets in a build dictionary
check_entity_attributes: run check_attributes to validate a single entity against its kind's allowed attributes
create_one_of_validator: create a one_of validator that checks if a value is in a given set of allowed values
create_subset_of_validator: create a subset_of validator that checks if all elements are in a given set of values
create_anything_validator: create an anything validator that accepts any value without raising an error
